entities.name: Sol'Kanar
entities.description: A Force of Nature from Dominaria, once a nature spirit of Khone, corrupted by Geyadrone Dihada and later a demon king of Corondor.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: Planeswalker who corrupted Sol'Kanar into her minion.

entities.name: Sivitri Scarzam
entities.description: Planeswalker who raided Corondor with Scarzam Dragons.

entities.name: Scarzam Dragons
entities.description: Dragons used by Sivitri, killed by a poppy poison.

entities.name: Dakkon
entities.description: Planeswalker who forged the Black Blade, defeated Sol'Kanar and became Dihada's champion.

entities.name: Black Blade
entities.description: Sword forged by Dakkon for Dihada and given to Sol'Kanar.

entities.name: Chondeah
entities.description: Spellcaster of Shikar who helped summon a dragon.

entities.name: Gydolien Mor
entities.description: Spellcaster of Khone who forced the dragon back and plotted revenge on Chondeah.

entities.name: Khone
entities.description: Forest kingdom turned into a swamp and destroyed by Sol'Kanar.

entities.name: Shikar
entities.description: Kingdom that grew glorious after Khone's fall.

entities.name: Sulgh
entities.description: Land south of Khone where Sol'Kanar became leader.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Island of Dominaria where Sol'Kanar rules.

entities.name: Unholy Citadel
entities.description: A giant castle walking on spidery limbs built from the bones of the dead.

entities.name: Blackblade-Dihada War
entities.description: War in which Sol'Kanar served as Dihada's champion.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Summoned and bound Sol'Kanar in an unpublished comic.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: For whom Sol'Kanar worked in an unpublished comic.

entities.name: Heart of the Mountain
entities.description: Sacred stone in Sol'Kanar's chest in the Dungeons & Dragons version.

events.summary: Sivitri raids southeastern Corondor with dragons until poppy poison from Sol'Kanar kills the Scarzam Dragons and she leaves Dominaria.
events.quote: Before Sivitri, astride the last and largest Scarzam Dragon, dozens of creatures were killed, leaving Dominaria for other planar conquests.

events.summary: Dihada twists Sol'Kanar into her minion, turns Khone into a swamp, and he wages war in her name.
events.quote: She turned Khone into a large swamp

events.summary: Dakkon defeats Sol'Kanar, whom Dihada then discards as she tricks Dakkon into becoming her champion.
Sol'Kanar moves to Sulgh and becomes its leader, demanding annual tribute.
events.quote: became the undisputed leader of the land

events.summary: Sol'Kanar, Chondeah and Gydolien summon a Scarzam Dragon ridden by Sivitri, who attacks him; Gydolien forces them back and Sol'Kanar destroys Khone in a rage.
events.quote: destroyed the kingdom of Khone in a rage

relations.note: Attacked him as source of the poppies
relations.quote: Sivitri recognized Sol'Kanar as the source of the poppies that had slain her dragons and attacked him.
